description: Governor's Office - Western Province - Extended the period of Investigation of single person inquiry Board - Wattala Mabola Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an inquiry being conducted by a judicial officer (retired Judge of the Court of Appeal) into potential offenses committed by a local government body and its chairman. The content is focused on a law enforcement and judicial investigation process, falling squarely under the "Judicial/Law Enforcement" category (Type 9) for legal proceedings, court orders, and judicial officer appointments.
